claims.text: Reader has Rendered, Raw and Split views; each converted file is its own document
Edit in Raw view or Split view's raw column; Rendered view is display-only
Page-label and chunk-marker comments appear as plain text in the rendered reader
Exports include the edited text, including the last unsaved keystrokes
Session saved at conversion, up to five; after an edit it still held the original; retried download fetches the stored result
Over 50,000 characters the formatted preview pauses in Split and Rendered; Raw and exports keep full text; Render full preview button; edits and switching pause again
Copy is current document, .md is current document, .zip is every result
Second report.md saved as report (2).md in the ZIP; clipboard block shows a notice
Files deleted from the service 48 hours after upload by default
Edits are not uploaded and don't change the stored converted result
claims.source: contentUpdated only updates local state (queueModel.js); no API call in useConverterViewModel.updateContent
